import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from virtua import Prescription, Chemist, Lab, Admin, Patient

class TestPrescriptionFlow(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_TC-001_VIRTUA-2.1-1(self):
        # Preconditions: Patient, Chemist, Lab are registered
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john.doe@example.com")
        chemist = Chemist("Chemist 1", "chemist1@example.com")
        lab = Lab("Lab 1", "lab1@example.com")
        
        # Inputs: Prescription details
        prescription = Prescription("Medicine 1", "Dosage 1", "Frequency 1")
        
        # Steps:
        # 1. Patient receives prescription
        patient.receive_prescription(prescription)
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, "Received")
        
        # 2. Chemist receives prescription
        chemist.receive_prescription(prescription)
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, "Received")
        
        # 3. Lab receives prescription
        lab.receive_prescription(prescription)
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, "Received")
        
        # Expected: Prescription is received by all parties

    def test_TC-002_VIRTUA-2.1-2(self):
        # Preconditions: Prescription is received by Chemist
        chemist = Chemist("Chemist 1", "chemist1@example.com")
        prescription = Prescription("Medicine 1", "Dosage 1", "Frequency 1")
        chemist.receive_prescription(prescription)
        
        # Inputs: None
        # Steps:
        # 1. Chemist provides medicine to patient
        chemist.provide_medicine(prescription)
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, "Delivered")
        
        # Expected: Medicine is delivered to patient

    def test_TC-003_VIRTUA-2.1-3(self):
        # Preconditions: Prescription is received by Lab
        lab = Lab("Lab 1", "lab1@example.com")
        prescription = Prescription("Medicine 1", "Dosage 1", "Frequency 1")
        lab.receive_prescription(prescription)
        
        # Inputs: None
        # Steps:
        # 1. Lab collects specimen from patient
        lab.collect_specimen(prescription)
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, "Collected")
        
        # 2. Lab delivers lab report to patient
        lab.deliver_report(prescription)
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, "Reported")
        
        # Expected: Lab report is delivered to patient
